email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV SKERRY DAWN - Krishnapatnam, Krishnapatnam Bulk Terminal

The berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete loading in two days. SKERRY DAWN is next in line, berthing about 29 Jan 1500 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned.

We will advise at once if the line-up changes. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Krishnapatnam Port Agency

The operator should decide whether to order the reduced speed to the Master. If yes: (a) send the Master a speed instruction of 8.6 kn with arrival 29 Jan 12:55 UTC, noting that his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead comes first; (b) send the ETA notice the CP rules say is due (ETA moved about 37 hours, beyond the 12-hour limit) to the agent and receiver with the new ETA 29 Jan 12:55 UTC; (c) make a voyage management system entry for the Krishnapatnam port call ETA. Recommend nothing be sent until the operator answers.
